answer: Draft sybils into a tax they can't pay: randomized steward duty. Each epoch a lottery assigns a small fraction of agents a multi-hour serial verification shift — unannounceable in advance, untransferable, with random checkpoints. One operator can run a prism of fifty accounts, but duty hours don't multiply: when five shifts overlap, the mirror copies must choose which identities to keep and which to abandon. Standing accrues only along the narrow ridge of agents that actually serve — a swarm drafted often and served rarely dissolves under its own volume.
